points.description: Identifies/detects the candidate distribution(s) from the data (e.g. by analysing the time series or plotting/inspecting its distribution) and then fits the chosen distribution/model to the data (estimates parameters).
points.partial_credit: Half if only one of the two steps (identifying the distribution OR fitting the model) is stated.

points.description: Checks the goodness of fit of the fitted model, naming the chi-square test, and analyses/interprets the results.
points.partial_credit: Half if goodness of fit is mentioned without naming chi-square test (or chi-square named without the idea of checking the fit/analysing results).

rubric.notes: Full marks need both stages: identify and fit a distribution to the series, then test goodness of fit using the chi-square test and analyse results. Give part marks when a stage is vague or only half of it is given (e.g. goodness of fit without naming chi-square). Give no marks for unrelated methods or answers that don't describe selecting, fitting and testing a distribution.
